Tooltip_SQChum_Bag:
Use one full bag and 0.1 L of water to make 5 vanilla chum bases.
The bag must be full. The empty bag and water container are retained.
Accepts clean water, tainted water, or a mixture of the two; no other liquids.
Uses vanilla chum recipe knowledge. Add bait after crafting.
Tooltip_SQChum_Clay:
Use 1 clay and 0.1 L of water to make 5 vanilla chum bases.
Accepts any native fluid water container and retains it after crafting.
Accepts clean water, tainted water, or a mixture of the two; no other liquids.
Uses vanilla chum recipe knowledge. Add bait after crafting.
